A satellite system including a set of at least three satellites in a formation, wherein at least two antenna arrays of at least two separate satellites in the set are directed in mutually different directions and at least one of the satellites in the set comprises a propulsion system, and wherein the satellite system comprises a control system configured to dynamically change the configuration and shape of said formation by controlling the propulsion system of at least one of the satellites in the set.
2.
